help.title: Imihlahlandlela
help.sub: Konkhe lokwentiwa ku-app, emhlahlandleleni lomfishane lokhombisa kahle kutsi kanjani. Kute kulandzisa, tikrini nje.
help.tourSub: Umhlahlandlela lomfishane wekusesha ligama lakho lekucala.

demo.example: Umntfwana lofuna kwati ubute imibuto leminyenti.

search.s2: Gadit ikhombisa tonkhe tinchazelo, hhayi yinye nje, ngayinye inetibonelo.

listen.desc: Cindzetela sipikha kute uve nobe nguliphi ligama liphinyiswa kahle.
listen.s2: Iva ligama liphinyiswa kahle, ngelulwimi lwalo.

niqqud.desc: Engeta ematinyo ekuphimisa eligameni lesiHebheru, nobe i-tashkeel kulesi-Arabhu.
niqqud.s2: Ligama litfola ematinyo ekuphimisa kute ulifundze kahle.
account.title: Khuphula futsi uphatse lihlelo
account.desc: Khuphula lihlelo bese uphatsa kubhalisa kwakho.
ui.sentencePh: (Kungakhetsiwa) Bhala umusho lapho ligama livela khona ute utfole inchazelo yalo lecondzile
ui.gadHint: Tsintsa nawusewucondzile, ligama bese limakwa njengelivakele ku-Incwadzi yakho
ui.savedNote: Leligama netinchazelo talo kugciniwe ku-Incwadzi yakho, futsi kuyatfolakala nalapho ungekho ku-inthanethi
ui.compose: Bhala umusho wakho ubone kutsi ulivisisile
ui.freeCount: {n} kulamashumi lamatsatfu emagama ku-Incwadzi yakho yemahhala
ui.installAndroid: Faka ngekutsintsa kanye, Gadit ivuleke njenge-app yangempela esikrinini sakho sasekhaya.
ui.dupBody: Ufuna kuphindze uxhumanise lephrofayela lekhona? Onkhe emagama nentfutfuko kuyagcinwa.
ui.reconnectNote: ✓ Kuphindze uxhumanise kubuyisa onkhe emagama nentfutfuko.
ui.joinLine: Unayo yini ikhodi yekuxhuma leyivela kumtali?
ui.joinSub: Bhala ikhodi yemadijithi lasitfupha leyentiwe ngumtali wakho
ui.leaderSub: Emagama lehlukene umuntfu ngamunye lawaseshile kuze kube nyalo
ui.recentSub: Onkhe emagama bantfwana bakho lawaseshile, lamasha kucala.
ui.alertsSub: Tfola izaziso ngako konkhe bantfwana bakho labakwentako ku-Gadit: emagama labawaseshako, idikteshini, tifundvo, imidlalo nekufundza.
ui.alertNowSub: Saziso masinyane nje nabaseshe ligama noma bacedze kuprakthiza.
ui.hwPickPicSub: Yiva ligama bese ukhetsa sitfombe saso kulamatsatfu
ui.ranksSub: Ubute emagama langu-{n}. Ligama ngalinye lelisha likukhuphula etulu
ui.toNext: Emagama langu-{n} lasele kute ukhuphuke lizinga
ui.readerSub: Namatsisela umbhalo, tsatsa sitfombe selikhasi, layisha sitfombe noma ubambe sikrini sakho.
ui.tapHint: Tsintsa noma nguliphi ligama ubone inchazelo yalo. Emagama lowavulile aba luhlata.
ui.saySub: Bhala umusho, khetsa lulwimi lolufundzako, bese uva kutsi ushiwo njani ngco.
ui.pasteListSub: Ligama linye emgceni ngamunye, ngelulwimi lwakho noma ngesiNgisi.
ui.pointsRule: Ligama lelisha = sinyatselo lesiya etulu · Kuphrakthiza lokucedziwe = ema-skin lamasha
ui.duelCardSub: Dlalani nibhekene: umtali nebantfwana, bazalwane noma bangani.
ui.duelSub: Imibuto lefanako kubobabili badlali. Kulunga nekushesha kuyawina.
ui.dSameSub: Dzulisani lithuluzi emkhatsini webadlali emvakwembuto ngamunye.
ui.dInviteSub: Tfumela ikhodi noma ilinki ku-family noma kumngani.
ui.dOnlineSub: Umdlali longahleliwe lobudzala bakho. Libitwana ne-avatar kuphela, akukho emabito nekungena kucoca.
ui.duelKidsSub: Nangabe loku kuvuliwe, bantfwana bakho bangadlala i-Word Duel nebantfwana labanye labalingana nabo labaku-inthanethi ngaleso sikhatsi. Babona libitwana ne-avatar kuphela.
ui.cxBody: Uchubeka nekutfola konkhe kuze kuphele sikhatsi sakho sanyalo. Ungaphindze uchubeke noma kunini ngaphambi kwaloko.
ui.pauseBody: Ungayimisa i-subscription inyanga yinye, ungabhadali lutfo. Konkhe kuhlala kunjengoba kunjalo, bese i-subscription ichubeka ngekutentakalela emvakwenyanga.
ui.renewBody: I-trial yakho ichubeka ize iyophela, futsi angeke kube nekubhadala.
demo.mySentence: Likati lami lelinesifiso lavula onkhe emabhokisi endlini.
demo.feedbackMsg: Kuhle kakhulu, usebentise 'curious' ngemcondvo lofanele ngco.
demo.hwList: lihabhula, sikolwa, umngani, luhlata sasibhakabhaka, thishela, insimu
search.desc: Bhala noma usho ligama ute utfole tonkhe tinchazelo talo, tibonelo, sitfombe kanye nemsuka walo.
search.s1: Bhala ligama ebhokisini lekusesha, noma utsintsse imayiki ulikhulume.
search.s3: Tsintsa 'Image' ngaphansi kwenchazelo ute ubone sitfombe sako.
search.s4: Ekugcineni: lapho ligama livela khona, bese kuba yinkinobho ye-'Gad it!'.
save.title: Incwadzi yakho iyatigcwalisa
save.desc: Onkhe emagama lowaseshako agcinwa ku-Incwadzi yakho ngekutentakalela.
save.s1: Onkhe emagama lowaseshako ayatigcina wona, akukho lokufanele ukutsintse.
save.s2: Kuze ubone emagama akho, vula 'Incwadzi' kumenyu lengenhla.
save.s3: Onkhe emagama akho akhona lapho, futsi kuletinhlelo letibhadalwako asebenta ngisho nangaphandle kwe-inthanethi.
save.s4: Ku-Basic, i-Notebook yemahhala igcina emagama lafikako ku-30.
context.title: Inchazelo lefanele yemusho wakho
context.desc: Engeta umusho lapho ligama livela khona ute utfole inchazelo yinye lefanele.
context.s1: Bhala ligama, bese enkundleni lengaphansi kwalo, ubhala umusho lapho livela khona.
context.s2: Gadit ikunikeza inchazelo yinye lefanele lowomusho.
context.s3: Leyo nkhundla lefanako ikhona ngaphansi kwebha yekusesha kuwo onkhe emakhasi emagama.
wordpage.title: Lokungetiwe ngeligama ngalinye
wordpage.desc: Bhala umusho wakho, tfola tibonelo letinyenti bese umaka ligama njengelivakele.
wordpage.s1: Ngaphansi kwenchazelo, tsintsa 'Write a sentence of your own and check you understood'.
wordpage.s2: Bhala noma usho umusho wakho, tsintsa 'Check sentence' bese utfola imphendvulo khona lapho.
wordpage.s3: Kuletinhlelo letibhadalwako, '+ More example sentences' yengeta tibonelo letintsatfu letinsha.
wordpage.s4: Ekugcineni, tsintsa 'Gad it!' bese ligama limakwa njengelivakele ku-Incwadzi yakho.
extras.title: Imibuto ngeligama
extras.desc: Kuletinhlelo letibhadalwako: lokuphambene, emagama lafanako, umndeni weligama, emaphutsa lavamile nendlela yekulikhumbula.
extras.s1: Emva kwe-'Gad it!', 'Have a question about this word?' ikunikeza imibuto lesihlanu.
extras.s2: Tsintsa umbuto bese imphendvulo iyavuleka ngaphansi ngco.
kids.title: Kids Mode
kids.desc: Iswishi yinye kubha lengenhla ichaza onkhe emagama ngendlela longawachazela ngayo umntfwana.
kids.s1: Ku-Family, vula iswishi ye-'Kids' eceleni kwelogo.
kids.s3: Ngesikhatsi kuvuliwe, imenyu ikhombisa 'Homework' esikhundleni se-'Practice'.
kids.s4: Kudivayisi lesabelwene ngayo, vula 'Shared kids screen' ku-My family, bese umntfwana ngamunye utsintsa sitfombe sakhe.
install.desc: Engeta Gadit esikrinini sakho sasekhaya ku-iPhone, noma uyifake ku-Android.
install.s1: Ku-iPhone, vula gadit.app ku-Safari bese utsintsa inkinobho ye-Yabelana.
install.s2: Skrola, ukhetse 'Add to Home Screen' bese utsintsa 'Add'.
install.s3: Ku-Android, faka i-app ye-Gadit ku-Google Play, noma utsintse 'Install' ku-Chrome.
install.s4: Nyalo Gadit ivuleka ngesithonjana sayo, njenge-app nje.
addchild.title: Engeta lilunga lemndeni
addchild.desc: Khetsa indzima, libito nemibala, kube nebantfwana labafika ku-5 ku-Family.
addchild.s1: Ku-My family, kuthebhu ye-Family, tsintsa 'Add a family member'.
addchild.s2: Khetsa indzima: Babe, Make, Indvodzana noma Indvodzakati.
addchild.s3: Bhala libito, ukhetse umbala, engeta budzala nawufuna, bese utsintsa 'Add to family'.
addchild.s4: Nangabe libito selivele liku-family, ungaphindze uxhumanise leyophrofayela ugcine emagama ayo.
pair.desc: Xhuma lithuluzi lemntfwana nge-QR code noma ikhodi yemadijithi lasitfupha.
pair.s1: Kuthebhu ye-Family, tsintsa 'Xhuma lithuluzi' ekhadini lemntfwana.
pair.s2: Skena i-QR code ngelithuluzi lemntfwana, noma uvule gadit.app/join lapho bese ubhala ikhodi.
pair.s3: Ku-iPhone, vula Gadit ngesithonjana sasekhaya bese utsintsa 'Enter code'.
pair.s4: Bhala emadijithi lasitfupha, futsi umntfwana lophindze waxhunywa utawutfola onkhe emagama akhe.
dash.s1: Vula 'My family' kumenyu ye-avatar, bese i-Home ithebhu ifinyeta i-family.
dash.s2: Umntfwana ngamunye unelikhadi leline-emagama, kuchubeka, lizinga nemagama lasandza kubukwa.
dash.s3: Emalengiso e-family akhombisa kutsi ngamunye wenu useshe emagama langakhi.
dash.s4: 'Recent lookups' ubala onkhe emagama bantfwana labawaseshile, lamasha kucala.
alerts.title: Tixwayiso ngebantfwana bakho
alerts.desc: Tfola tindzaba ngemagama, idikteshini, tifundvo, imidlalo, kufundza nema-duel.
alerts.s1: Ku-My family, ku-Settings, vula 'Tell me what my kids do in Gadit'.
alerts.s3: Khetsa lofuna kukuva ngako, bese uvula tixwayiso kanye kudivayisi ngayinye.
alerts.s4: Tixwayiso tifika nge-imeyili, nangendlela yebhena yefoni lapho kwenteka khona.
homework.title: Umsebenti wasekhaya
homework.desc: Kubantfwana labaku-Family: engeta umsebenti wasekhaya ngesitfombe noma ngokunamatsisela, bese uwuphrakthiza.
homework.s1: Ku-'Homework', tsintsa Photograph, Upload noma Paste kute wengete umsebenti wasekhaya walobubusuku.
homework.s2: Hlola emagama, khetsa kutsi yini futsi sivivinyo sinini, bese utsintsa Save.
homework.s3: Umsebenti wasekhaya ulindza ngaphansi kwa-'To do', eceleni kwekufundza emagama, kufundza nekulungiselela sivivinyo.
homework.s4: 'Learning words' kune-dikteshini, lalela ukhetse, umdlalo wetitfombe netifundvo telulwimi.
ranks.title: Emazinga, kuchubeka kanye nemalengiso e-family
ranks.desc: Ligama ngalinye lelisha likusondzeta elizingeni lelilandzelako, futsi kuphrakthiza lokucedziwe kuvula ema-skin lamasha.
ranks.s1: Tsintsa ibhejhi yelizinga kubha lengenhla ute ubone emazinga akho.
ranks.s2: Ligama ngalinye lelisha encwadzini yakho likukhuphula etikhundleni.
ranks.s3: Bantfwana babona kuchubeka kwemalanga, umgomo weliviki nelizinga labo, futsi emazinga laphakeme avula kubukeka lokusha.
ranks.s4: Emalengiso e-family ku-My family akhombisa kutsi ngubani loseshe emagama lamanyenti.
reader.desc: Tsatsa sitfombe, namatsisela noma layisha umbhalo, tsintsa noma nguliphi ligama, bese uhlola kutsi ulivisisile.
reader.s1: Ku-'Every Word', namatsisela umbhalo, tsatsa sitfombe selikhasi, layisha sitfombe noma i-PDF, noma yabelana ngesikrini sakho.
reader.s2: 'Key words in this text' ikhombisa emagama lafanele kufundvwa kucala.
reader.s3: Tsintsa noma nguliphi ligama ute ubone inchazelo yalo, futsi onkhe emagama lowavulako aba luhlata.
reader.s4: Ekugcineni, kuhlolwa kwekufundza kubuta kutsi emagama asho kutsini kulombhalo.
say.title: Kusho ngalolunye lulwimi
say.desc: Bhala umusho, khetsa lulwimi, uwuve bese uprakthiza kuwusho.
say.s1: Ku-'Say it', bhala noma urekhode umusho bese ukhetsa lulwimi lotawuliva ngalo.
say.s2: Tsintsa 'Say it' bese uva kutsi kuzwakala njani ngco.
say.s3: Bese utsintsa 'Practice saying it' bese uwusho ngekuphimisela.
say.s4: Utfola tinkhanyeti letifika kuletisihlanu, nelisu nawungakafiki khona.
practice.title: Prakthiza
practice.desc: Kubadzala labaku-Individual ne-Family: kufundza, kulungiselela sivivinyo, idikteshini nelulwimi.
practice.s2: Khetsa kokunye kulokune: kufundza, sivivinyo, idikteshini noma lulwimi.
practice.s3: Ngesivivinyo, namatsisela luhla lwemagama bese uprakthiza kuze kufike lilanga.
practice.s4: Ku-dikteshini uva ligama, ulibhale bese ubona sipelingi lesifanele.
games.title: Imidlalo yemagama
games.desc: Imidlalo ngemagama laku-Incwadzi yakho, kanye nalokungetiwe.
games.s3: Ngaphansi kuneminye imidlalo ngemisuka yemagama, emagama lacondzile nesakhiwo semagama.
games.s4: Umdlalo ngamunye lophelile ukusondzeza ku-skin lensha.
duel.title: Word Duel
duel.desc: Imibuto lefanako nibhekene ne-family, umngani noma i-Word Bot.
duel.s2: Dlala kulelithuluzi, mema ngekhodi noma ilinki, joyina ngekhodi, noma udlale ne-Word Bot.
duel.s3: Kuze udlale nemuntfu loku-inthanethi nyalo, umtali uvula 'Word Duel with other kids' ku-Settings.
duel.s4: Kulunga nekushesha kuyawina, futsi litafula lekuwina ligcina emaphuzu.
account.s1: Vula 'Account' kumenyu ye-avatar ute ubone luhlelo lwakho.
account.s2: Ku-Basic, tsintsa 'Upgrade to Family' noma 'Upgrade to Individual'.
account.s4: Kuhlelo lolubhatalwako, 'Manage billing' ne-'Change plan' kuphatsa lokusele.
cancel.title: Khansela, yimisa noma uvale kuvuselelwa
cancel.desc: Lokwentekako nawukhansela, kanye netindlela letimnene endleleni.
cancel.s1: Ku-Account, tsintsa 'Cancel subscription' bese ukhetsa sizatfu nawufuna.
cancel.s2: Kuhlelo lwenyanga, ungayimisa inyanga yinye esikhundleni saloko, ungabhadali lutfo.
cancel.s3: Ku-trial yemahhala, sizatfu lesitsi 'I didn't want an automatic charge' sikuvumela kutsi uvele uvale kuvuselelwa.
cancel.s4: Nawushintja umcondvo wakho, tsintsa 'I cancelled by mistake, keep the subscription'.
